evidence_boundary: This is an independent analytic Euler-Green reconstruction for the finite N=1 constant tangential member only. It reads no AD/FD result and cannot promote the multi-N Euler-Green gate, C1/N1, B4, or B5.

mathematical_contract.BF: E_B=F and E_A is the oriented covariant divergence of B; the radial integration-by-parts term is retained explicitly
mathematical_contract.EH_GHY: delta(S_EH+S_GHY)=-M5^3/2 int sqrt(-g) G^MN delta g_MN-M5^3/2 int_Sigma sqrt(-gamma) pi^mn delta gamma_mn
mathematical_contract.Omega: E_Omega=G box_g Omega with Green=-G int_Sigma sqrt(-gamma) n.dOmega deltaOmega
mathematical_contract.interface_N1: constant tangential mode has Kcal=Rcal=a=0; wall and Robin are algebraic weak Euler terms and Sigma=T4 has no corners
mathematical_contract.matter: E_phi=Z(D_M P^M-c_M P^M); E_Omega=(3Z/(2Omega)) div(phi.P); E_A=-Z phi cross P^M
